# SIDRAH LABS

> Sidrah Labs engineers reliable Databricks lakehouses with deterministic pipelines, explicit schema contracts, and pre-execution checks—forging foundational verification infrastructure from production data work.

Build data systems you can trust—and change safely.

## What we do

We engineer reliable Databricks lakehouses with deterministic pipelines, explicit schema contracts, and pre-execution checks. We deliver fixed-scope production deployments using battle-tested engineering harnesses—letting our hands-on work in production inform and harden the foundational software infrastructure we build.


## Fixed-scope deployments

- **Legacy ERP & hostile SQL to Databricks** (A / MIGRATION) — 14–21 days sprint target.
  Transition brittle, uncooperative source systems into a governed lakehouse foundation without turning the project into an indefinite rewrite.

  Focus: Source discovery · Incremental ingestion · Lakehouse delivery
- **Fivetran & SaaS pipeline off-ramp** (B / OWNERSHIP) — 14 days sprint target.
  Replace high-volume managed connectors with pipelines you own, understand, and operate—eliminating runaway row-sync taxes while keeping source parity.

  Focus: Source parity · Owned pipelines · Run-cost visibility
- **Databricks Asset Bundles CI/CD & DBU optimization** (C / DELIVERY) — 10 days sprint target.
  Standardize bundle-based multi-environment deployments, integrate schema validation gates, and eliminate avoidable compute spend across your clusters.

  Focus: Deployment harness · Environment setup · Compute review

TIMELINES ARE SPRINT TARGETS; FINAL SCOPE IS CONFIRMED AFTER A FOCUSED TECHNICAL DISCOVERY.

## How we deliver

We don't start from a blank repo or bill hours to reinvent standard plumbing. Each deployment adapts a modular set of proven engineering assets directly to your cloud.

- **Metadata ingestion framework**: Reusable patterns for source discovery, delta-tracking, and repeatable ingestion across structured enterprise systems.
- **One-click DABs CI/CD harness**: A consistent, automated deployment baseline for Databricks Asset Bundles across dev, staging, and production environments.
- **Pre-execution schema gates**: Explicit contract assertions that catch incompatible source mutations and type mismatches before pipelines run.

## Production experience

- **Self-service ERP lakehouse**: Engineered and delivered for production; operating continuously for more than two years without architectural regressions. (2+ YEARS RUNTIME)
- **Deterministic DataFrame rules engine**: Reusable, rule-based processing engine ensuring idempotent and predictable data transformations across complex business logic. (DATA INTEGRITY)
- **HealthAI extraction pipeline**: High-integrity extraction and transformation pipeline engineering for a Silicon Valley medical AI infrastructure team. (EXTRACTION PIPELINE)

## Applied R&D

As software and pipeline generation accelerates, the critical bottleneck shifts from writing code to knowing whether a proposed mutation is safe to run.


Our applied research explores AST- and SMT-based pre-execution query verification and deterministic pipeline testing. We believe durable infrastructure tools cannot be theorized in the abstract—they are forged by solving difficult, real-world data problems in production today.


THE WORK IN PERSPECTIVE: Hands-on deployments fund our independence and sharpen our engineering judgment; our verification research guides how we build resilient data systems.
